title: Count the matches, now with count()
prompt: Same task as before: how many items equal value. This time use the built-in count method instead of a loop.
signature: func solve(items: Array, value: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(items: Array, value: int) -> int:
	return 0
hint: One line. The method takes the value to look for.
solution:
func solve(items: Array, value: int) -> int:
	return items.count(value)
